people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.
translations.bsb: And Joseph took both of them—with Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand—and brought them close to him.
translations.kjv: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near
translations.asv: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.
